entities.name: RlmN-like protein
observations: 361-aa query matches reviewed Clostridium perfringens RlmN at 66.5% identity and 93.9% query coverage (E=1.61e-167).
Sequence scan identifies RlmN_N (PF21016.4; residues 17–74) and Radical_SAM (PF04055.28; residues 120–280).
Homology-based function: dual-specificity methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA; associated annotation indicates a [4Fe-4S] cluster and cytoplasmic localization.
Computed properties: 40.9 kDa, pI 5.78; functional assignment remains inferred from homologs, not direct assay of this query.
